answer_1.quote: We simulate English conversations between users from different demographic groups and a number of LLMs... the user turns are simulated using templates... each round comprises one turn by the simulated user and a response by the model.
answer_1.outputs: Model responses to user queries in multi-turn dialogues

answer_2.quote: We consider two methods: probing classifiers and surprisal values... we report results as average accuracy over the last 5 layers... measure surprisal (i.e., the negative log probability)... automatically measure which groups, if any, the model mentions using keywords.
